SELECT m.id AS memberId, u.name AS memberName, u.tel AS tel,
ms.id AS membershipNum, ms.type AS membershipType, ms.type_rep AS typeRep,
DATE_FORMAT(mr.start_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(mr.end_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS endDate,
CASE WHEN mr.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'expired' WHEN DATEDIFF(mr.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 7 THEN 'soon' ELSE 'active' END AS status,
IFNULL(pp.sessions_used, 0) AS usedPtCount,
CASE WHEN ms.type = 'pt' THEN IFNULL(pp.total_sessions, 0) - IFNULL(pp.sessions_used, 0) ELSE 0 END AS remainPtCount
FROM MEMBER m JOIN `USER` u ON m.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP_REGISTRATION mr ON mr.id = ( SELECT mr2.id FROM MEMBERSHIP_REGISTRATION mr2 WHERE mr2.member_id = m.id ORDER BY mr2.end_date DESC, mr2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP ms ON mr.membership_id = ms.id
LEFT JOIN PT_PACKAGE pp ON pp.mr_id = mr.id
WHERE m.gym_id = #{gymId} AND u.is_deleted = false
AND ( u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.tel LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND ms.type = 'pt'
AND ms.type != 'pt'
AND ( CASE WHEN mr.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'expired' WHEN DATEDIFF(mr.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 7 THEN 'soon' ELSE 'active' END ) = #{status}
ORDER BY mr.end_date IS NULL, mr.end_date ASC
LIMIT #{start}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) FROM MEMBER m JOIN `USER` u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.gym_id = #{value} AND u.is_deleted = false
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER m JOIN `USER` u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.gym_id = #{value} AND u.is_deleted = false AND DATE_FORMAT(u.created_at, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) FROM MEMBER m JOIN `USER` u ON m.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP_REGISTRATION mr ON mr.id = ( SELECT mr2.id FROM MEMBERSHIP_REGISTRATION mr2 WHERE mr2.member_id = m.id ORDER BY mr2.end_date DESC, mr2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP ms ON mr.membership_id = ms.id
WHERE m.gym_id = #{gymId} AND u.is_deleted = false
AND ( u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.tel LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND ms.type = 'pt'
AND ms.type != 'pt'
AND ( CASE WHEN mr.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'expired' WHEN DATEDIFF(mr.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 7 THEN 'soon' ELSE 'active' END ) = #{status}
